name: TWITTER 骓特 Cyclone R7120 aero build
why_interesting: An exact official Cyclone 3rd R7120 build now supplies weight, drivetrain, bottom-bracket, tire, size and image evidence for the dated China-market price lead.
missing: Exact model year/SKU, complete BOM, and exact domestic warranty route

facts.complete_weight_status: Current manufacturer conflict: 8.7 kg regional configurable page versus 9.3 kg global specification; size, accessories and weighing protocol do not reconcile the values
facts.complete_weight_basis: Regional exact-page base estimate retained for the catalog row; treat as conflicted with the current 9.3 kg global specification
facts.tire_clearance_status: Manufacturer maximum not found after 50 registered source areas; fitted 28C tire is not treated as clearance
facts.frame_material: High-modulus carbon frame with full-carbon fork; exact fiber grade and lay-up unpublished
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer describes the exact Cyclone 3rd chassis as engineered for aerodynamic stability and efficient power delivery; qualitative claim without a numeric protocol

source_note: Current exact manufacturer pages agree on the high-modulus carbon platform and qualitative power-delivery claim but conflict on complete weight: 8.7 kg regionally versus 9.3 kg globally. Both show fitted 700x28C tires without a manufacturer maximum.
